lead.headline: China Confirms Talks Underway on Historic Xi-Trump-Putin Meeting
lead.summary: Beijing said discussions are under way on a possible three-way summit of the Chinese, U.S. and Russian leaders. No date or final agreement has been announced.

tech.headline: Nvidia Retakes World's Biggest Company Title From Apple on Election Day
tech.summary: Nvidia overtook Apple to again become the world's most valuable company on Election Day. The move reflects continued swings in AI-related stocks.

business.headline: Nasdaq and S&P 500 Rebound as Dow Slips, Capping a Bruising Week for AI Stocks
business.summary: Tech-heavy indexes bounced back on Friday after a sharp midweek selloff. The jobs report and earnings were in focus.

business.headline: Moderna Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings
business.summary: Moderna released its third-quarter results on Nov. 6. CNBC's page covers the vaccine maker's quarterly numbers.

business.headline: Why US Midterm Voters Opted for Economic Populism
business.summary: A Bloomberg newsletter looks at how economic concerns shaped the midterm results. It examines what the populist tilt could mean for markets and policy.

world.headline: Will Trump Strike Iran's Nuclear Sites Again as Tehran Wages 'Cognitive Warfare'?
world.summary: Al Jazeera looks at whether Washington will resume strikes on Iranian nuclear sites. The analysis comes as the U.S. is reported to have hit Qeshm Island while Trump says talks with Tehran are going well.

world.headline: Russia Says It Hit Ukrainian Postal Hub and Ship as Kyiv Strikes Ryazan Refinery
world.summary: Russia said it struck a Ukrainian postal hub and a ship. Ukraine reported hitting an oil refinery in Russia's Ryazan region.

opinion.headline: The Republicans Who Love to Lose
opinion.summary: Lehman argues that blaming the midterm defeat on demographic change lets Republicans off the hook for the poor policy choices that turned voters against the GOP in two years. He says this theory absolves the party of responsibility for its historic loss.
opinion.author: Charles Fain Lehman

opinion.headline: The Utter Failure of Republican Redistricting Opens a Door
opinion.summary: Gebelhoff says one welcome result of Tuesday's rout was the failure of the GOP's gerrymandering effort to save its House majority. Democrats kept almost all the redrawn seats and picked up some North Carolina seats the new maps had made more vulnerable. He argues this gives both parties a chance to de-escalate the redistricting war.
opinion.author: Robert Gebelhoff

opinion.headline: Democrats Can Now Fix the Supreme Court Without Reforming It
opinion.summary: Feldman argues that a Democratic Senate can block any further Trump Supreme Court pick. He says that should make Democrats rethink plans to pack the court or strip its jurisdiction. If a Democrat wins the presidency in 2028 and the party holds the Senate, he writes, it could flip the court from 6-3 conservative to 5-4 liberal.
opinion.author: Noah Feldman

opinion.headline: Rebuilding US Foreign Policy After Trump
opinion.summary: The authors argue that the Iran war and tariffs loomed large in the Republican midterm wipeout, and that many of Trump's foreign policy choices are unlikely to endure. They expect the new Congress to use oversight, including possible impeachment proceedings against Hegseth, to restrain or reverse some of them. They also note that some of his policies will be hard to undo in the short run.
opinion.author: Jonathan Monten, Jordan Tama and Joshua Busby

sports.headline: Red Sox Boss Hints at Clear Offseason Goal Beyond Adding Offense
sports.summary: Sports Illustrated reports on what Boston's baseball leadership is prioritizing this winter besides adding hitters.

sports.headline: NFL Week 9 Bold Predictions: Jefferson Feasts on Bills, Commanders Upset Rams
sports.summary: NFL.com's analysts make bold calls for Sunday's slate of games.
